answer.sql: WITH tx_total AS (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS total_hospitals FROM hq.hospitals WHERE is_texas), latest_period AS (SELECT mv.facility_id, UPPER(mv.measure_id) AS measure_key, MAX(mv.period_end) AS period_end FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id WHERE h.is_texas GROUP BY mv.facility_id, UPPER(mv.measure_id)), scored AS (SELECT lp.measure_key, COUNT(DISTINCT mv.facility_id) FILTER(WHERE mv.score IS NOT NULL) AS hospitals_with_score FROM latest_period AS lp JOIN hq.measure_values AS mv ON mv.facility_id = lp.facility_id AND UPPER(mv.measure_id) = lp.measure_key AND mv.period_end = lp.period_end GROUP BY lp.measure_key) SELECT m.measure_id, m.domain, LEFT(m.measure_name, 60) AS measure_name, COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0) AS hospitals_with_score, t.total_hospitals AS total_texas_hospitals, ROUND((CAST((t.total_hospitals - COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0)) AS DECIMAL) / t.total_hospitals) * 100, 1) AS percent_missing FROM hq.measures AS m CROSS JOIN tx_total AS t LEFT JOIN scored AS s ON UPPER(m.measure_id) = s.measure_key WHERE (t.total_hospitals - COALESCE(s.hospitals_with_score, 0)) * 2 > t.total_hospitals ORDER BY percent_missing DESC, m.measure_id LIMIT 25

records.question: For Texas hospitals, compare the average 'would definitely recommend' percentage and the average overall star rating by ownership type. Count every Texas hospital of the type (even without a recommend score), keep only types with at least 5 hospitals, and list the highest average recommend percentage first.

answer.question: For Texas hospitals, compare the average 'would definitely recommend' percentage and the average overall star rating by ownership type. Count every Texas hospital of the type (even without a recommend score), keep only types with at least 5 hospitals, and list the highest average recommend percentage first.
answer.answer: Among Texas ownership types with at least 5 hospitals, averages are listed from highest to lowest recommend percentage (hospital count; average recommend percentage; average overall stars): Government - Local (11; 79.0%; 3.0), Government - State (15; 79.0%; 3.67), Physician (27; 78.85%; 3.67), Government - Hospital District or Authority (78; 75.73%; 2.77), Voluntary non-profit - Other (18; 74.36%; 3.43), Veterans Health Administration (5; 74.2%; 4.4), Voluntary non-profit - Private (134; 73.52%; 3.7), Voluntary non-profit - Church (5; 73.5%; 3.75), and Proprietary (171; 68.58%; 3.01). Hospital counts include every Texas hospital in each type, including those without a recommend score.
answer.sql: SELECT h.hospital_ownership AS ownership_type, COUNT(*) AS texas_hospital_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(c.top_box_pct) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_definitely_recommend_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.overall_rating) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_overall_star_rating FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_hcahps AS c ON c.facility_id = h.facility_id AND UPPER(c.measure_id) = UPPER('H_RECMND_DY') WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE GROUP BY h.hospital_ownership HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY AVG(c.top_box_pct) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

answer.sql: WITH measure_data AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, measure_id, score FROM hq.v_tx_latest WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'SEP_1') AND score IS NOT NULL), measure_stats AS (SELECT measure_id, AVG(score) AS mean_score, STDDEV(score) AS sd_score FROM measure_data GROUP BY measure_id), stats AS (SELECT MAX(mean_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS pn_mean, MAX(sd_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS pn_sd, MAX(mean_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS recommend_mean, MAX(sd_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS recommend_sd, MAX(mean_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'SEP_1') AS sepsis_mean, MAX(sd_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'SEP_1') AS sepsis_sd FROM measure_stats), hospital_values AS (SELECT facility_id, MAX(facility_name) AS facility_name, MAX(county) AS county, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS pn_readmission, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS recommend_pct, MAX(score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'SEP_1') AS sepsis_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT measure_id) AS measure_count FROM measure_data GROUP BY facility_id), scored AS (SELECT h.facility_name, h.county, (s.pn_mean - h.pn_readmission) / NULLIF(s.pn_sd, 0) AS pn_z, (h.recommend_pct - s.recommend_mean) / NULLIF(s.recommend_sd, 0) AS recommend_z, (h.sepsis_pct - s.sepsis_mean) / NULLIF(s.sepsis_sd, 0) AS sepsis_z, ((s.pn_mean - h.pn_readmission) / NULLIF(s.pn_sd, 0) + (h.recommend_pct - s.recommend_mean) / NULLIF(s.recommend_sd, 0) + (h.sepsis_pct - s.sepsis_mean) / NULLIF(s.sepsis_sd, 0)) / 3.0 AS composite FROM hospital_values AS h CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE h.measure_count = 3), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite DESC, facility_name, county) AS high_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite ASC, facility_name, county) AS low_rank FROM scored), selected AS (SELECT 'Top' AS group_name, high_rank AS group_rank, facility_name, county, composite, pn_z, recommend_z, sepsis_z FROM ranked WHERE high_rank <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'Bottom' AS group_name, low_rank AS group_rank, facility_name, county, composite, pn_z, recommend_z, sepsis_z FROM ranked WHERE low_rank <= 10) SELECT group_name, facility_name, county, ROUND(CAST(composite AS DECIMAL), 2) AS composite_z, ROUND(CAST(pn_z AS DECIMAL), 2) AS pneumonia_readmission_z, ROUND(CAST(recommend_z AS DECIMAL), 2) AS recommend_definitely_z, ROUND(CAST(sepsis_z AS DECIMAL), 2) AS sepsis_care_z FROM selected ORDER BY CASE group_name WHEN 'Top' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, group_rank LIMIT 200

answer.sql: WITH selected_measures AS (SELECT measure_id, measure_name, higher_is_better FROM hq.measures WHERE measure_id IN ('READM_30_PN', 'MORT_30_HF', 'HAI_1_SIR', 'SEP_1', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'H_STAR_RATING')), ranked_scores AS (SELECT mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.score, h.state, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, mv.period_start DESC NULLS LAST) AS period_rank FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id JOIN selected_measures AS sm ON sm.measure_id = mv.measure_id WHERE mv.score IS NOT NULL), latest_scores AS (SELECT facility_id, measure_id, score, state FROM ranked_scores WHERE period_rank = 1), measure_averages AS (SELECT measure_id, AVG(score) AS national_average FROM latest_scores GROUP BY measure_id), results AS (SELECT sm.measure_id, sm.measure_name, ma.national_average, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE ls.state = 'TX') AS texas_hospitals_with_score, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE ls.state = 'TX' AND CASE WHEN sm.higher_is_better THEN ls.score > ma.national_average ELSE ls.score < ma.national_average END) AS texas_hospitals_beating_national FROM selected_measures AS sm JOIN latest_scores AS ls ON ls.measure_id = sm.measure_id JOIN measure_averages AS ma ON ma.measure_id = sm.measure_id GROUP BY sm.measure_id, sm.measure_name, sm.higher_is_better, ma.national_average) SELECT measure_id, measure_name, ROUND(CAST(national_average AS DECIMAL), 2) AS national_average, texas_hospitals_with_score, texas_hospitals_beating_national, ROUND(100.0 * texas_hospitals_beating_national / NULLIF(texas_hospitals_with_score, 0), 1) AS texas_share_beating_pct FROM results ORDER BY texas_share_beating_pct DESC, measure_id ASC LIMIT 200
